claims.statement: Ben Hogan put up $1,000 of his own money and was trained for his match with Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: He put up $1,000 of his own money and I trained him forthe fight.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Ben Hogan, and the referee Bill Riley declared the fight a draw after Hogan's corner claimed a foul and the crowd came into the ring with knives and revolvers.
claims.excerpt: The crowd cut In the ring and pulled knives and revolvers on Alen and his his seconds. The referee declared ita draw.

quotes.speaker: John Sweeney
quotes.text: Allen was a great body-flghter anda man who fights continually for the body will get below the belt.

fights.excerpt: The crowd cut In the ring and pulled knives and revolvers on Alen and his his seconds. The referee declared ita draw.
fights.notes: Told by Hogan's old trainer John Sweeney; one side's account. He says there were two rounds of hard fighting, then Allen's right went into Hogan's stomach and Sweeney claimed a foul. Fight date and place not given; the article says it was Hogan's last fight.

notes: Recollection by Hogan's trainer, printed 1888-04-03. The Chicago conversation and religious work concern Hogan, not Allen.
